title: tc-code-block
description: Streaming code with syntax colours, Copy, Apply, and a line diff against the current file.

code.description: The code; it may grow every frame while streaming

language.description: Language for the colours: ts, tsx, js, jsx, py, json, html, xml, css, sh/bash, or plain

filename.description: File name shown in the head, e.g. "src/auth/session.ts"

current.description: The file as it is now. When given, a Diff button shows the changes the code would make

view.description: "code" or "diff". Changed by the user unless a tc-view-change listener calls preventDefault()

streaming.description: The code is still coming in: a caret blinks at the end, Diff and Apply wait

applied.description: The code has been applied: Apply turns into a disabled "Applied"

wrap.description: Wrap long lines instead of scrolling sideways

maxHeight.description: Cap the body's height in px (0: grow with the code); a capped body scrolls and follows the end while streaming

bare.description: No tray or card around it – for use inside another component's card
